## Column1 {width = "35%"}

```{r, loadpackages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(gt)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
```


```{r, getrecentobservations}

#Define ebird API key.
api_key <- Sys.getenv("api_key")

#API Call
recent_obs <- request("https://api.ebird.org/v2/data/obs/US-MI-049/recent") |> 
  req_headers(
    `X-eBirdApiToken` = api_key,
  ) |> 
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

# Create dataframe of recent observations.
recent_obs_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, recent_obs))

# Convert lists to vectors
recent_obs_df <- 
  recent_obs_df |>
  mutate(speciesCode = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$speciesCode))) |>
  mutate(comName = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$comName))) |>
  mutate(sciName = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$sciName))) |>
  mutate(locId = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$locId))) |>
  mutate(locName = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$locName))) |>
  mutate(obsDt = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$obsDt))) |>
  mutate(howMany = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$howMany))) |>
  mutate(speciesCode = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$speciesCode))) |>
  mutate(lat = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$lat))) |>
  mutate(lng = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$lng))) |>
  mutate(obsValid = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$obsValid))) |>
  mutate(obsReviewed = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$obsReviewed))) |>
  mutate(locationPrivate = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$locationPrivate))) |>
  mutate(subId = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$subId))) |>
  mutate(exoticCategory = as.vector(unlist(recent_obs_df$exoticCategory)))
```

```{r, createtable}
# Create dashboard table
recent_obs_df |>
  select(comName, obsDt, locName, howMany) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    comName = md("**Common Name**"),
    obsDt = md("**Date**"),
    locName = md("**Location**"),
    howMany = md("**Number Seen**")
  )
  
```


## Column2 {width = "65%"}

### Row {height = "10%"}

```{r, sendtoojs}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
ojs_define(recent_obs_ojs = recent_obs_df)
```

```{ojs}
//| expandable: false
// Transpose the data to make it usable in ojs.
recent_observations = transpose(recent_obs_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the species common name.
viewof locNameDropdown = Inputs.select(
  recent_observations.map(d => d.locName),
  {
    label: "Choose a location",
    unique: true
    }
)
```

### Row {.fill}

```{ojs}
//| expandable: false

  filtered_loc = recent_observations.filter(function(locName) {
  return locNameDropdown.includes(locName.locNameDropdown);
 })

Plot.plot({
  marks: [
  Plot.barX(
  filtered_loc,
  {x: "howMany", y: "comName", sort:{y: "x", reverse: true}})
  ],
  marginLeft: 200,
  filter: d => locNameDropdown.includes(d.locName)
})
```
